svg.title: From a 28 by 31 character map to two OpenMC geometries
svg.desc: The full 868-character Pac-Man map appears at left. Two branching arrows point to an OpenMC rectangular lattice rendered as tiles and a CSG maze rendered as merged rectangular corridors. Both represent the same geometry.
svg.text: From a tiny text map to two geometries
A whole Pac-Man maze, with no CAD model.
[868 B data · ~0.9 kB with line breaks]
